cards.card_text: Nehemiah tells the nobles of Judah that by profaning the Sabbath, they're rekindling God's wrath against Israel.
cards.verse_text: And now you are rekindling His wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath!”
cards.snippet: And now you are rekindling His wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath!”

cards.card_text: What else does he keep without profaning it?
cards.verse_text: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
cards.snippet: …son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”

cards.card_text: God gives the reason for His oath: they kept rejecting His ordinances and profaning His Sabbaths, for their ___ continually went after their idols.
cards.verse_text: because they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.
cards.snippet: …they kept rejecting My ordinances, refusing to walk in My statutes, and profaning My Sabbaths; for their hearts continually went after their idols.
